orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Fenn "Haggle Engine" (thrust x1.3, fragile), a hull mount (outward is up): outside, four slim nozzles of different heights standing on a thin cream pad, joined by steel struts, with a blinking antenna between them and a small quick flame on each (3 frames); a collar through the wall; inside, a cream core of gear trains (they turn on the loop), small dials, a row of lamps, a hatch and a coupling. Damaged: the second nozzle has cracked off its neck and hangs, a gear is loose, sparks. Disabled: nozzles bent and dark, the antenna snapped, gears stopped. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
